title: Harvest and House
author: Silas Sandoval
blurb: Xanthe Reyes, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
